title: Disruptive technologies and manufacturing performance in South Africa: firm-level evidence
summary: The paper tests whether adopting disruptive digital technologies improves the performance of South African manufacturing firms. It addresses a thin evidence base on technology adoption and digital skills in developing countries and discusses implications for national Fourth Industrial Revolution policy.
keyFindings: Adoption of disruptive digital technologies matters for manufacturing firm performance.
methods: Econometric analysis of firm-level South African digital skills survey data.
